body:
The first time I smoked Salvia it completely shattered everything I believed about life and existence.
After my first hit I started laughing uncontrollably because I realized how funny it was that all this time I believed this life was real. Everything I was looking at became almost fake...like energy...really hard to describe.
I took another hit and held it in for as long as I could...I was staring at my ipod...Tool's Vicarious way playing...when suddenly my ipod turned into a cartoon...then I got SUCKED OUT OF MY BODY.
Directly behind me is the best I can describe the other dimension I now go to every time I smoke Salvia. First I can see and understand how reality is made...how this life was all a dream I walked up to and immersed myself in a long time ago. I don't only see...I REMEMBER IT. AND IT IS TERRIFYING!
I also see little people 'making reality' but behind that is a pop up book reality. I leave my body on my bed (really scary for me at the time). I start looking around and realize my whole life was just a game, that my body was only a shell holding my consciousness, and I then forget I smoked anything at all. It was like 'wakening up' from a dream...a dream that was my whole life. The story book land was very pink/red and more familiar than my life now.
The next thing I know there is a mother figure in white to my left (I don't know why but she seemed like my mother...but she wasn't my actual mother in real life.) I look around and I am about 2 years old and sitting on the floor of the house I lived in until I was 3. This was just as real as anything. She said ' pick up the brush!' and I suddenly become the brush on the floor next to me. It was like putting on a life...almost like putting on a mask. I then become stuck in reality after reality. They go by faster and faster. Suddenly one reality starts repeating over and over. I understand Ive been stuck in a single moment for all of eternity, and that this will never change. I start to get really scared, because I have no idea I smoked Salvia. I think I will never stop this never ending 2 second loop where I open a door and shut it.
After what feels like 1,000 years I start to come back to this reality. I start FREAKING OUT (I was alone, no sitter) and grabbing anything I can in my room, knocking everything over, trying to find my Salvia so I can get rid of it. As I hold onto my purse, my gloves, my phone I'm hoping it will keep me in my normal reality with my friends and family. I keep slipping back and forth between Salvia world and this one. Ive honestly never been so scared. When I finally come back, I was so amazed at the entire experience. I pick up my bowl about 15 minute later and smoke some more.
The SAME THING starts to happen again...I see the little people behind our reality, and I see the story book land again, and can feel myself starting to leave my body. I instantly remember everything, get really scared (and wonder why I did this again) and fight to stay in my body, which I do.
I feel strongly that Salvia shows us the truth of existence, and that it also blocks a lot from your memory during the time your not smoking Salvia. Truly an amazing plant that deserves respect.
